## What to include

Along with your presentation slides, provide a brief summary of your project in the **README** of your repository. It should cover:

1. **The dataset** you are using.
2. **Your research question(s).**
3. **Your methodology.**
4. **Your findings.**

The executive summary is evaluated on whether it **follows the guidance** and whether it is **concise but detailed enough**. Style and format count, so make sure code and outputs look good.

## Repo folder tree

```
your-group-repo/
├── presentation.Rmd    # slides (source)
├── presentation.html   # slides (rendered)
├── README.Rmd          # executive summary (source)
├── README.md           # executive summary (rendered)
├── data/               # dataset (CSV or RDS) and data dictionary
└── proposal/           # the project proposal
```

## Before you submit

- Review the documents on GitHub to make sure you are happy with the final state.
- Check that the data and code are properly formatted.
- Make sure every team member has contributed, and that every member understands how and why the code works.
